card.name: Words leading into death or disaster
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or a year just before a word for a death, accident or disaster. Examples are 'of' before 'dying', 'is a' before 'death', and a year before 'shipwreck'.

modes.label: Before a death or accident
modes.description: A linking word or comma right before a word like death, dying or shipwreck.
modes.example: the odds<< of>> dying while driving on Election Day

modes.label: Death or birth lists
modes.description: Words inside a phrase listing life events such as death or birth.
modes.example: significantly aspected when there is a death (or birth),<< or>> the ending or beginning of a significant

modes.label: Before a crisis
modes.description: A verb or article just before a setback, trauma or sudden call.
modes.example: his wife<< suffered>> a setback following surgery

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for accidents, car crashes, bankruptcy and proposals, which are major life events.
card.plain: It lights up on the words just before a death, accident or other major life event is named.
